import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long MOD;
    static class ModInt {
        long val;
        ModInt(long v) {
            val = v;
            if (MOD != 0 && (val >= MOD || val < 0)) {
                val = (val % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        static ModInt modPow(ModInt base, long exp) {
            long b = base.val, res = 1;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    res = (res * b) % MOD;
                }
                b = (b * b) % MOD;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        
        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            val += other.val;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt sub(ModInt other) {
            val = (val - other.val + MOD) % MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt mul(ModInt other) {
            val = (val * other.val) % MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            if (other.val == 0) {
                throw new AssertionError("Division by zero");
            }
            return this.mul(modPow(other, MOD - 2));
        }
        
        ModInt addNew(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt(this.val).add(other);
        }
        
        ModInt subNew(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt(this.val).sub(other);
        }
        
        ModInt mulNew(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt(this.val).mul(other);
        }
        
        ModInt divNew(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt(this.val).div(other);
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(val);
        }
    }
    
    static int N, M;
    static ModInt[] dp1 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[] dp2 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[][] dp3 = new ModInt[505][505];
    static ModInt[][] dp4 = new ModInt[505][505];
    
    static long[] fact = new long[400001];
    static long[] invFact = new long[400001];
    static long[] inv = new long[400001];
    
    static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (fact[0] == 0) {
            inv[1] = fact[0] = invFact[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= 400000; ++i) {
                inv[i] = inv[(int)(MOD % i)] * (MOD - MOD / i) % MOD;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= 400000; ++i) {
                fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
                invFact[i] = invFact[i-1] * inv[i] % MOD;
            }
        }
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return invFact[r] * fact[n] % MOD * invFact[n-r] % MOD;
    }
    
    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextLong();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
            dp1[i] = new ModInt(0);
            dp2[i] = new ModInt(0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= N; ++j) {
                dp3[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
                dp4[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        
        dp1[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                ModInt term = new ModInt(i+1).mulNew(dp1[j-1]).mulNew(dp1[i-j]).mulNew(new ModInt(nCr(i-1, j-1)));
                dp1[i] = dp1[i].addNew(term);
                
                ModInt term2 = new ModInt(i+1).mulNew(dp2[i-j].mulNew(dp1[j-1]).addNew(dp1[i-j].mulNew(dp2[j-1]))).mulNew(new ModInt(nCr(i-1, j-1)));
                dp2[i] = dp2[i].addNew(term2);
                
                ModInt term3 = dp1[j-1].mulNew(dp1[i-j]).mulNew(new ModInt(nCr(i-1, j-1))).mulNew(new ModInt(nCr(j, 2) + nCr(i-j+1, 2)));
                dp2[i] = dp2[i].addNew(term3);
            }
        }
        
        dp3[0][0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                dp3[i][j] = dp3[i-1][j];
                dp4[i][j] = dp4[i-1][j];
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; ++l) {
                    ModInt term1 = dp1[l].mulNew(dp3[i-l-1][j-l]).mulNew(new ModInt(nCr(j, l)));
                    dp3[i][j] = dp3[i][j].addNew(term1);
                    
                    ModInt term2 = dp1[l].mulNew(dp4[i-l-1][j-l]).addNew(dp2[l].mulNew(dp3[i-l-1][j-l])).mulNew(new ModInt(nCr(j, l)));
                    dp4[i][j] = dp4[i][j].addNew(term2);
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i] = dp1[i];
            dp4[i][i] = dp2[i];
        }
        
        System.out.println(dp4[N][M].val);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
